text:
Tess: Quick double announcement — I got promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and also we’re expecting a baby in Sept! thinking potluck + tiny celebration next Friday? :party_parrot:
Omar: OMG huge congrats!! :tada: count me in for potluck and decorations
Sophia: WOOO!!! congrats tessa!! 🥳 so happy for you both
Grace: This is the best news. I'll bring plates & napkins, and GF brownies. Want me to coordinate with People Ops for the promo blurb?
Liam: Love this. Congrats! When does the promo go live? Also cake pls :cake:
Julie: I'll bring cupcakes (vegan option too). Congrats, Tess!!
DeployBot: Note: office fridge cleanup runs Sunday 7pm — please label anything you want to keep. :fridge:
Tess: Thanks everyone!! Promo is effective next Monday, People Ops looped in already. Potluck plan: 12:30–1:30pm in the kitchen, I'll send a calendar invite. Registry link later, no pressure :)
Omar: I'll bring a sandwich platter and a little folding table. Also can we have a small "Congrats Tess" banner? I can grab one on my way in.
Sophia: I'll make a banner tomorrow after work — what color theme? Also can someone add a few song recs for the playlist?
Grace: Neutral + confetti sounds great. I'll handle labeling GF options. Congrats again!! :heart:
Liam: Adding tentative event to calendar now. DJ line-up: I'll start with mellow acoustic then ramp to celebratory jams. Drop song recs here.
Julie: Song rec: "Good as Hell" and "Lovely Day". Also I can bring a little herb bouquet for the table centerpiece.
Tess: Neutral + confetti it is. Seriously, thanks y'all — can't wait to celebrate. Feeling very loved 😭❤️
